name: Claude handoff
author: Brett
description: Moves AmberX AXF to a new Claude account. Builds and keeps current the handoff kit in _claude/handoff/ (entry point, reading order, claude.ai Project instructions and knowledge, every instruction/rule/memory/spec file, copies of each machine's ~/.claude files, the claude.ai-side items, secret names) and assembles the one prompt that, typed into a new session on the new account, clones the repo and sets everything up from those files. Publishes the kit to GitHub; reminds every 6 hours with one banner and one alert (overwritten, never stacked). Tools → Installer preview runs the installer with example data; Tools → Installer look picks its layout, gauge and progress-meter styles and the app's light/dark colour and style themes, with a roll that changes only what is switched on in a token tree; saved on axHub's data server. Lives in the console's Tools section.

keeps: _claude/handoff/ in the repo: the published kit a new Claude account reads; take it out by hand (git rm) if it is no longer wanted
